primary.decision: Reassess after pilot; do not launch bulk automatically
primary.budget_note: 500 RUB is a proposed stop budget, not a guarantee of completing 24 attempts. Full envelope allowance would be ~4735.77 RUB; choose budget after pilot measurements.

supplemental.status: prepared outside 24-attempt primary schedule; budget/count separately before execution

request_envelope.bound_type: Conservative byte-based reservation, not observed tokens or provider billing guarantee
request_envelope.on_envelope_exceeded: stop attempt and record; never shorten schemas/prompts selectively
request_envelope.on_missing_usage_or_transport_error: retain reservation; charge not assumed zero
request_envelope.on_budget_exhausted: stop and retain all failed attempts
